audit.why: Real spikes already named: level-2 double-bomb kill threat on a dashless target, level 4-5 maxed-Time-Bomb all-in window before her ult, level 6 Crescendo (undodgeable point-and-click AoE stun) answered by Chronoshift rather than dodged, and item-tempo parity after.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no cooldown digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and breakdown.trading/dosFull[1].d/dontsFull[2].d ignore two applicable missingInteractions: Sona's Power Chord/Hymn of Valor auto-reset tell, and her Q on-hit scaling with attack-speed items.
audit.why: Sona's Crescendo is 140/120/100s, giving a real countdown. Power Chord procs every few spell casts and telegraphs her burst before the auto lands — a step-back cue, not a reaction to the ability cast. Hymn of Valor applies on-hit effects, so it scales with attack-speed items and armor alone underrates the poke.
